required_repair.statement: For an old quotient-skeleton class q and target class q_y, unary polynomial types induce a fixed finite family of homomorphisms from M_q=G_q/K_q to M_y=G_y/K_y. A candidate displacement v is unsafe iff one of a fixed finite family of additive combinations L maps v to ybar.
required_repair.unsafe_set: BAD_q(y) = {0} union over L in Lambda_(q->y) of L^{-1}(ybar)
required_repair.algorithm: constant-union affine-coset avoidance using finite-abelian-group linear algebra, inclusion-exclusion, and witness self-reduction
source_support: BMS Theorem 2.2: term operations are affine/linear between abelian congruence blocks
BMS Claim 6.6: Algorithm 8 generates the unary-polynomial contribution set H
BMS Claim 6.7: target membership equals subgroup membership generated by all generator contributions relative to their own rho-class representatives
BMS Algorithm 8 runtime: polynomial types and coordinate types are bounded by constants depending only on fixed K

separator_audit.safeext_maximalization: Repeated safe extensions terminate polynomially because every strict invariant extension changes a compact feature and recompaction is polynomial in the residual-small cube-term regime.
separator_audit.maximality: No safe extension implies S is maximal among invariant superrelations excluding y; Sg(S union {y}) is the unique cover.
separator_audit.criticality: Maximal separator is meet-irreducible; after constructive dummy deletion it is critical.
separator_audit.dummy_test: coordinate i is essential iff there exists a in A_i with y^{i<-a} in S; otherwise maximality forces proj_-i(S) x A_i = S
separator_audit.parallelogram_admission: For y in the frozen low-arity shell but outside R, the essential arity of a separator cannot be below the edge threshold; Theorem 20/BK source then supplies the parallelogram property.
separator_audit.outer_count: At most n*|A|^2 nonredundant critical conjuncts by the source signature-drop bound.

normalization_audit.subdirect: Restrict each sort to the unary projection of the relation.
normalization_audit.nonreduced_to_reduced: PASS by coordinate linkedness quotients and full inverse-image reconstruction.
normalization_audit.reduced_recursion: PASS by A_12, quotient graph Q, homomorphic image R', and arity n->n-1.
normalization_audit.multisorted_to_fixed_basis: PASS using fixed factor universe and fixed projection-graph/tuple encodings; all factor lookup data are constant infrastructure for fixed K.
